medium.en: Fan mounted as an album leaf; ink and colour on silk
medium.zh: 团扇，装为册页，绢本设色

basis.en: Song dynasty painting of the late 10th century; the painter is unrecorded. The Metropolitan Museum of Art releases this image under CC0 through its Open Access programme.
basis.zh: 宋代绘画，作于 10 世纪后期，画家佚名。大都会艺术博物馆通过开放获取计划以 CC0 发布此图像。

alt.en: A round fan painting on dark silk, set in a pale patterned mount. A rocky bank with a leaning tree stands at the left; snow lies on low roofs, rocks and a small wooden bridge along the shore, and a wide, still river stretches to faint hills on the far side.
alt.zh: 一幅深色绢本团扇，衬在浅色花纹的裱绫上。左边是一段长着斜树的岩岸；雪落在岸边低矮的屋顶、石头和一座小木桥上，宽阔平静的河面一直延伸到对岸隐约的山。

note.en: One of the oldest paintings on this wall, made more than a thousand years ago by a painter whose name did not survive. The colours have deepened, but the composition is still clear: a shore, a bridge, a few houses and a great deal of quiet water. A library holds many works like this, where the work outlived the name.
note.zh: 这是这面墙上最古老的画之一，作于一千多年前，画家的名字没有留下来。颜色已经变深，但构图依然清楚：一段岸、一座桥、几间屋，和大片安静的水。图书馆里有许多这样的作品——作品比名字活得更久。
